caption: Creamy yellow tonkotsu broth with visible noodles and green onions sits in a white ceramic bowl with a glossy, slightly textured rim. Dark green nori and pinkish chashu pork rest on the wooden table with warm brown grain patterns.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly glossy surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
